app_name: ADHD Habit Tracker, To Do List
title: Perfect for improving productivity
body:
I’m a control freak and always wondering whether I forgot to do something, but thanks to this app I’ll never have to wonder again! 

Also it’s perfect to stick to my new habits: 15 mins of daily yoga, drinking enough glasses of water etc etc. This app can be used for literally everything 

Amazing!!
author: lh301994
